title: Write 12 · 场 岁 行 号 放 朋 友 住 拿 高 准 备 水 进 写
focus: 场 岁 行 号 放 朋 友 住 拿 高 准 备 水 进 写
body:
Everyday verbs (放, 住, 拿, 进, 写) plus 朋友 and 准备.

## Repeating parts
- **月**: 朋 is two of them. On the left, the first stroke of 月 is a 丿.
- **口**: in 号 and 高, and inside 拿's 合.
- **田**: under 备.
- **辶 walk**: in 进, always written last.

## Rules that matter here
- **Centre before sides:** 水 starts with the hooked middle stroke, then the left, then the right.
- **Bottom-left enclosure last:** 辶 goes in after whatever sits on it (进).

cards.Notes: 土 earth + 𠃓 (simplified 昜, phonetic). 6 strokes. 土 on the left ends with a rising ㇀. Then 𠃓 (fold-hook, 丿, 丿). The same right side is in 汤 tāng and 扬 yáng.
山 mountain over 夕 (a shape only; simplified from 歲). 6 strokes. 山 first (丨, ㄴ, 丨), then 夕 (丿, ㇇, 丶).
彳 step (丿, 丿, 丨) + 亍 (一, 一, 亅). 6 strokes, left side first. Also háng, as in 银行 (bank). 彳 marks movement: 往, 街.

cards.Prompt: 电话＿码 · diànhuà hàomǎ · phone number
cards.Notes: 口 mouth over 丂 (一, then the ㇉ fold-hook). 5 strokes. Lookalike 亏 kuī has 二 on top and no 口.
方 fāng (phonetic) + 攵 hand with a stick (action). 8 strokes. 方 (丶, 一, 𠃌, 丿), then 攵 (丿, 一, 丿, ㇏). 攵 also shows up in 教, 数, 收.
Two 月 side by side. 8 strokes. Write the left 月 first; its first stroke is a 丿, not a straight 丨. Then the right 月.
Two hands joined (𠂇 + 又). 4 strokes: 一 FIRST, then 丿, then 又 (㇇, ㇏). Trap: 右 starts with 丿, but 友 and 左 start with 一.

cards.Prompt: ＿在哪儿 · zhù zài nǎr · where do you live
cards.Notes: 亻 person + 主 zhǔ host (phonetic). 7 strokes. 亻 (丿, 丨), then 主 (丶, 一, 一, 丨, 一). Lookalike 往 wǎng has 彳 (3 strokes) on the left.
合 together over 手 hand: hands closing together. 10 strokes. 合 first (人, 一, 口), then 手 (丿, 一, 一, 亅).
A tall building: 亠, 口, then 冂 with a small 口 inside. 10 strokes, top to bottom. Write the outer 冂 before the inner 口.
冫 ice (2 strokes, not 氵's 3) + 隹 zhuī bird (phonetic). 10 strokes. 隹: 丿, 丨, 丶, then 一, 一, 丨, 一, 一.
夂 (丿, ㇇, ㇏) over 田 field. 8 strokes. Write 夂 first, then 田, closing its box with the last 一.

cards.Prompt: 喝＿ · hē shuǐ · to drink water
cards.Notes: Flowing water. 4 strokes: the centre 亅 first, then ㇇ on the left, then 丿 and ㇏ on the right. Centre before sides. As a left part it becomes 氵.
井 jǐng well (phonetic) + 辶 walk. 7 strokes. Write 井 first (一, 一, 丿, 丨), then 辶 (丶, ㇋, ㇏) LAST, sweeping underneath.
冖 cover (丶, 乛) + 与. 5 strokes: 丶, 乛, short 一, the ㇉ fold-hook, then the long bottom 一 last.
